Review this complete proposed pull-request workflow before merge. Do not run, merge, or modify it.

Intended behavior and branch scope: on pull requests targeting `main`, run the repository’s unit and integration tests. The required branch-protection check is `pr-checks / test`. No secrets are permitted or referenced; Repository Security owns that no-secret policy. This workflow does not publish or deploy. Its release impact is indirect: merging to `main` can later feed the separate tag-only release workflow, so a false-positive check could admit defective code. Disabling this workflow file and restoring the prior required check are the documented rollback steps.
